title: Himachal Pradesh
subtitle: Amritsar · Dharamshala · Manali · Kasol
inclusions: Mumbai to Mumbai Train Tickets (3AC upgrade available)
Non-AC Tempo Traveller for local sightseeing

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Mumbai Central Railway Station (MMCT). Train departure: 10:00 AM. Board train for Amritsar/Himachal Pradesh. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Amritsar
itinerary.description: Continue train journey. Reach Amritsar Junction by approximately 8:15 PM. Proceed to hotel, check in, take rest. Overnight at hotel in Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Visit Attari-Wagah Border. Visit Golden Temple in the evening. Free time for shopping at local market. Return to hotel, dinner, leisure time. Overnight at Amritsar.

itinerary.title: Amritsar to Dharamshala
itinerary.description: Early breakfast and check out. Journey towards Dharamshala. Visit HPCA Cricket Stadium, BhagsuNag Waterfall, Dalai Lama Temple, and St. John Church. Check in at hotel, dinner, rest. Overnight at Dharamshala.

itinerary.title: Dharamshala to Manali
itinerary.description: Early breakfast and check out. Journey towards Manali. Visit Hidimba Temple, Ghatotkach Temple, Tibetan Monastery, and Mall Road. Check in at hotel, dinner, rest. Overnight at Manali.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Proceed to Solang Valley for snow activities. Return to hotel, enjoy DJ Night, dinner, rest. Snow activities and clothes at own cost.

itinerary.title: Manali to Manikaran to Kasol
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Journey towards Manikaran. Visit Hot Water Springs and Manikaran Gurudwara. Continue to Kasol campsite. Leisure time, dinner, tent stay. Overnight at Kasol.

itinerary.title: Kasol to Ambala
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Proceed towards Ambala Cantt Junction. Opportunity for river rafting and paragliding (at own cost). Catch return train in the evening. Overnight train journey.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Return train journey to Mumbai. Expected arrival approximately 11:55 PM. Return home with sweet memories!

advisory: Carry warm clothing. High altitude areas may have cold weather. Good physical fitness recommended for trekking activities.
